issue.summary: On the Teamily Web client, typing "@" in the message input of a chat conversation intermittently fails to open the member/agent selection picker, so the user cannot mention anyone. Switching to another conversation and back restores the picker. Reproduced during a live meeting by the reporter. Suspected root cause: the @-mention member list is not reloaded / its state is not reset on conversation switch (stale cache, or a failed member-list request that is not retried).
steps: Open a chat conversation in the Teamily Web client.
In the message input box, type "@" to start a mention.
Observe that the member/agent selection picker does not pop up (intermittent — happens sometimes, not every time).
Switch to another conversation, then switch back to the original one.
Type "@" again — the picker now appears and mentioning works normally.
issue.expected: Typing "@" in the message input box reliably opens the member/agent selection picker, allowing the user to mention any member or agent, regardless of how the conversation was entered.
issue.actual: The @-mention selection picker sometimes does not appear after typing "@" — no member/agent list is shown and the user cannot mention anyone. The feature only recovers after switching to another conversation and back. Confirmed on the Web client, also reproduced during a meeting.
issue.context:
- **Feature area**: Messaging / @-mention
- Suspected cause: @-mention member list loading or state refresh issue — the picker state is not reset when the conversation changes, the member-list request fails silently, or a stale/corrupted cache is used.
- Suggested investigation: check the mention member-list request on conversation switch (does it re-fire? is the response cached?); verify the picker open-state / member-list state store is reset on conversation change; add a retry or re-fetch path when the member list is empty/stale.
- Screenshot provided by reporter — the original CDN link returned HTTP 404 when this issue was filed (link likely expired); please ask the reporter to re-share if visual evidence is needed: https://teamily-storage.becdn.net/im/images/4203662271075754/76c85a8b-2660-49e6-96e4-f17bdf4472f6.msg_picture_17890104170000001339_0.png
- Related existing issues (different platforms / symptoms, not duplicates): #1400 [Mobile] group chat @-mention only shows partial members; #1265 / #485 group chat @-mention member list incomplete; #865 [iOS] @ mention cannot be triggered in long-text editing view; #184 / #186 mention autocomplete does not show suggestions when typing '@T'.
